shared_elements: low-relief human figures shown in profile
bearded male figures with patterned hair/beard
continuous horizontal frieze band with figures moving in one direction
horizontal ground line / border strip beneath figures
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile with weapons, carved in shallow relief as a continuous horizontal frieze marching left-to-right above a plain ground strip, and both share conventions of patterned hair/beard and overlapping profile bodies. The decisive difference is subject: A is a static, endlessly repeated procession of standing robed attendants in stacked registers, whereas B is a single dynamic hunt scene with a wheeled chariot, harnessed horses, drawn bows and attacking and collapsing lions — none of which appear in A.
